hypothesis: A fresh stationary native 68-electron reference reproduces the scale of the published DHF attachment energies before any correlation correction; a fixed two-basis comparison distinguishes radial error from the later correlation gap.

paper.unknowns: 40-GTO exponents, nuclear model/parameters, exact DHF DC/Breit separation, correlated partitions and solver controls remain unknown.

fixed.nucleus: Fermi empirical radius selected by A171; not an experimental radius and not an asserted paper input
fixed.grid: pure exponential native make_knots, not the paper GTO basis
fixed.hamiltonian: Dirac-Coulomb only, rest energy subtracted; no recoil/QED/Breit
fixed.electron_projector: native solve_dirac positive branch, stored-core S-orthogonal complement for attached orbitals
fixed.comparison_zero: E(Yb69 frozen core)-E(Yb68) = valence Fock eigenvalue
fixed.optimization: closed68-electron DHF only; no69-electron MCDHF claim

acceptance.paper: Observed difference from rounded row only; numerical agreement is not exact input/method reproduction or experimental accuracy.

resources.estimate: 19 core and3 attached radial orbitals, seven Fock pencils/arm, three complete electron eigensystems/arm; largest active pencil433 and at most217 electron columns; four singleton CI blocks/arm; <256MiB retained NumPy payload/arm, <2GiB anticipated RSS.

stopping: Stop on first identity, convergence, residual or resource failure; preserve partial results. No automatic retry, radial-size scan, relaxed gate, fitted energy, borrowed paper correction or backend execution.
